name: Inside-Outside Voxelization
aliases: Inside-Outside Voxelization — Stencil Shadow Volume Voxelization, Stencil-based Interior Voxelize
definition: Determines whether a grid cell is inside or outside a solid obstacle using stencil buffer operations, inspired by stencil shadow volumes.
summary: Inside-Outside Voxelization uses stencil buffer operations to classify grid cells as interior or exterior based on closed mesh topology, distinguishing it from boundary-only methods.
